commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.
90+5' The corner from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is hurriedly cleared.
90+5' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Samu Costa will be replaced by Chiquinho (Mallorca).
87' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Hugo Alvarez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Substitution. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) on for Fran Beltran.
84' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Cyle Larin and he is replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
84' Substitution. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daniel Rodriguez walks off.

82' 2 - 0 Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) scores a goal from medium range. He finds some space to collect a pass and produces a low drive that goes inside the net. The goalkeeper couldn't make a save, despite the ball going into the middle of the goal.
80' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) and blew his whistle.
78' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
76' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
73' The resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared.

73' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
67' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
66' Golden chance! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
65' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) replacing Williot Swedberg.
65' It is time for a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is on for Borja Iglesias.
64' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
64' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

63' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul. Mallorca will take a free kick.
62' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:7.
60' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Here is a change. Javier Llabres is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Johan Mojica (Mallorca).
58' That's the end of the game for Robert Navarro (Mallorca), who is replaced by Vedat Muriqi.
57' Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
57' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
56' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle.
54' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
53' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

53' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
52' Celta Vigo fail to score from a corner as Dominik Greif (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
52' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Celta Vigo get a corner.
49' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
47' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the direct free kick, but drags his shot well wide of the left post.
45+1' Dangerous play by Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Celta Vigo.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' This is a yellow card! Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
44' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
43' Problems for Claudio Giraldez as Fernando Lopez is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replaces him.
42' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!

41' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Vicente Guaita pulls off a fine save to deny him.

41' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mallorca will take a free kick near the side line.

39' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
38' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
36' Samu Costa (Mallorca) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Ball possession – 52:48.
32' 1 - 0 Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) latches on to a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His shot went in off the right post. Fabulous goal!
31' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea stops the game and makes a call.
28' Mallorca are ruled offside.
25' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea saw the whole situation.
25' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
21' It looks like Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) saw red with that tackle. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
20' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.
15' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
14' Samu Costa (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' Some great controlled play and passing from Mallorca. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

7' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Vicente Guaita displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
6' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
4' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Mallorca are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
